271:The production UI is **`/srv/git/3tched.com`** (github.com/repr0bated/3tched.com; not in this repo). It is a SvelteKit + Svelte + Vite chat app using `@json-render/svelte` that talks only to the `:8090` door (one generic `PluginService/CallMethod` over gRPC-Web, exactly one OIA1 or SID1 credential) and that op-web serves as static files from `/usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard/` — the dashboard root, `http://<host>:8080/`. The pinned release archive of that checkout is `vendor/3tched-json-render-ui`.

273:**Owner UI stack rule (2026-10-11):** implement application interfaces only
274:with Svelte/SvelteKit, Vite and json-render's Svelte renderer. This applies to
275:every user and chat mode, including generated interfaces. Every visible UI
276:element must be declared in the active catalog and implemented in its registry.
277:Installed skills for other frameworks are reference material only; they do
278:not authorize React/JSX/Next.js components,
279:another renderer, or framework dependencies in this application. Apply their
280:framework-independent guidance only where it fits this stack. The shared
281:UI-authoring preflight applies across modes; each caller keeps its existing
282:grants. Documentation availability never grants file or operation access.

285:# Build and deploy at op-web's root (from the UI repo)
286:cd /srv/git/3tched.com && LANDING=prod VITE_OPDBUS_DOOR=https://10.0.0.2:8090 npm run publish:op-web
287:cd /srv/git/3tched.com && URL_PREFIX=/ VITE_OPDBUS_DOOR=https://10.0.0.2:8090 npm run publish:op-web
288:
289:# Dev server
290:cd /srv/git/3tched.com && npm run dev
291:```
292:
293:`LANDING` is the mount name under the static root (`live`, `prod`, `3tched`). `URL_PREFIX=/` is the dashboard root, and there the script replaces only `assets/` and `index.html`. A named mount is a separate directory under that root. op-web does **not** embed the UI via RustEmbed — it serves the deployed static files. There is no pairing. The current op-web identity endpoint refuses to infer a browser identity from a TCP source address; remote pickup uses the decoy issuer or an authenticated injecting host page.
294:
295:On the configured HTTP pages at `10.0.0.2:8080` and `10.0.0.4:8080`, the UI uses op-web's existing same-origin Axum gRPC-Web connector, which forwards the unchanged identity metadata to the TLS door at `10.0.0.2:8090`. Other origins keep the direct HTTPS door. The generic `PluginService/CallMethod`, sealed capabilities, and interceptor identity checks remain the admission path; the connector does not mint or select an identity.
296:

298:`vendor/3tched-json-render-ui/build-assets.sh`. That helper builds and checks the
299:captured UI without the sibling checkout or live rsync; golden preparation
300:stages only its validated asset archive and provenance manifest.
